rv.q: But, although Nunn directs the whole event with great efficiency, one is left wondering why he bothered.
What happens? Very little, and the play, which bristles with a job lot of funny lines that aren’t actually funny, expires slowly around its perpetrators until it stops in a fractious stalemate.

cn.t: Critics dismiss this revival as hollow Broadway hokum that fails to justify its staging, with Goldman's 1966 play proving toothless and meretricious despite its movie fame.
